sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The page has three panels: template list on the left, HTML editor in the middle, live preview on the right. Each change is reflected instantly in the preview.

bullets.desc: Click "New Template" on the left panel, enter a name and HTML content, then click "Save".
Click an existing template on the left panel to edit it.
Mark a template as default with the star icon. It is auto-selected when creating users or assigning a single signature.
After saving the template you can add media files via Google Drive URLs.

callout.text: To check in bulk whether signatures stay up to date over time, use the Signature Audit page — it compares people's signatures against current system data and bulk-updates the ones that drifted.

sections.heading: HTML Template Structure
paragraphs: Email signatures render across many clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, etc.), so a few rules apply:

bullets.desc: — layouts built with the table tag give the most consistent results across all clients.
— write styles with the style attribute. External CSS or style blocks are not supported.

callout.text: Allowed tags: table, tr, td, th, img, a, br, p, div, span, b, i, u, strong, em, font, hr

sections.heading: Variable Tags
paragraphs: Insert variables with double curly braces. They are filled per user from Google Admin data when the signature is applied.

sections.heading: Conditional Block
paragraphs: Hide an HTML element entirely when a variable is empty. For example, a phone row is hidden for users without a phone number.

code.label: Single condition:
code.note: If phone is empty this row is removed entirely.

code.label: Multiple conditions (comma-separated):
code.note: Hidden only when both phone and title are empty. Visible if any one is set.

callout.text: Use the orange "Conditional Block" button in the editor to wrap selected text easily.

sections.heading: Width Limit
paragraphs: Add a width limit to prevent long text (especially addresses) from breaking the signature layout.

code.label: Usage:
code.note: The address text is shown at most 350px wide; long text wraps to a new line.

bullets.desc: Turkish address abbreviations (Mah., Sk., Cad., No:, etc.) are auto-protected — no line break before them.
Can be applied to any variable, but is most useful for institution_address.

callout.text: Use the teal "Width Limit" button in the editor by placing the cursor inside a variable.

sections.heading: Example Template
paragraphs: The template below shows how a logo, conditional title/phone rows and a width-limited address work together:

code.content:
{{full_name}}
{{title}}
 {{institution_name}}
Tel: {{phone}}
 {{email}}
{{institution_address|max-width:350}}
